quest.title: The Great Mage's Journey of Trials
quest.description: The witch's dictionary also includes an assignment that Alice left for Klee. Why not drop by the Knights of Favonius headquarters and ask Klee about it?
quest.rewards_formatted: Hero's Wit x3, Guide to Freedom x3, Mora x30000

chapter.title: Witch's Homework: Of Leaves That Spark

talks.objective: Go to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Hmm... Dodoco...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there, Klee!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #{M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight! Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Dodoco needs help! Mom said you were coming, but I didn't know it'd be so soon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Dodoco... needs help?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, for Pete's sake... Is that the task?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: What? No, for Klee's sake! And for Dodoco, too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, Paimon knows that. She was asking about the task. You know what that is, right? It's like a...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Thank you, Honorary Knight of Fav-Obvious.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, um... A task is... Gah, why is it so hard to describe!? It's like... helping Dodoco! Yeah! That's a task!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Oh! Thanks, Paimon. That kinda makes more sense, although not really.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Anyway, let's go help Dodoco now!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hold on. What kind of help does Dodoco need?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Oh, right. Well, every Dodoco's gotta find a red four-leaf clover to become a super special Dodoco.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Then, Dodoco needs to become friends with lots of people and can make it through the Dodo-King's trial. Once that's done, she can then become a super awesome...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Dodo-Sorcerer!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: ...That's what Mom said, anyway.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, a Dodo-King being in charge of a Dodo-Sorcerer... Makes sense, actually.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, but specifically, what do we need to do?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: No idea.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: But Mom said that you two would tell me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: R—Right... Well, let's have a look at this book then...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Oh! There's a note inside it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, let's see what it says...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...At the first stage of the trial, Dodoco arrived in a forest of whispering leaves. There, past layer upon layer of hurdles, a secret lay buried, waiting to be uncovered...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seems like part of a story about Dodoco...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Oh, I know where that forest is! It's where I go to blast— Ahem, where I go to play a lot!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: C'mon, everyone! Follow me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, let's go!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, something that needs doing!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Oh! So, like... when I go blast-fishing with Jumpy Dumpty?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, no! A "task" isn't just something you wanna do!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I'm confused...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* It's like... When your mom tells you to do something! That's a "task"!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's with all the weird stuff around here? And why are there so many Hilichurls?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, maybe the Hilichurls brought it all here?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Ohhhh, I bet this is where we find the turtles!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Close, but the note said "hurdles," not "turtles."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And whatever we're looking for is supposed to be buried past all "the hurdles"... Huh, are there any other clues around?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is there no Dodo-device that can help us out here?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Uh... nope.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What should we do, then?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Hmm... Mom says the best thing to do when you run into a problem is to try and fix it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then let us be rid of these hurdles.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yeah!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, that's the Hilichurls and barriers all taken care of...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And we didn't set the forest on fire.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I was extra careful with Jumpy Dumpty!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I've been getting sent to confinement less and less these days!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nice job, Klee!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe sometime soon, you won't have to go at all...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Well, if Master Jean would just let Klee blow the confinement room up...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's not really what Paimon had in mind... Wait, what about the trial? Did we learn anything new?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yep! I found this in the hole Jumpy Dumpty created after exploding...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, another note.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yup, and it's mom's handwriting again...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Now then, Dodoco may or may not have blasted all the hurdles away — though the most direct approach is sometimes the most elegant one. Either way, thus did Dodoco make it to the second stage of the trial..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Which, coincidentally, was also the final stage. Even the most energetic of children need to pace themselves, after all. So..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Dodoco proceeded to the banks of a lake of fallen stars, passed the final trial, and obtained her reward. But could things really be that simple...?"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, "a lake of fallen stars"... That must be Starfell Lake!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go see what we can find.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Alright!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's super curious about what this reward's gonna be. Fingers crossed for some kind of awesome treasure!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Oooh, it's a chest!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The final treasure must be inside this thing...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Klee, would you do honors...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: You got it! Me and Dodoco will get it open, no problem!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, wait a second... Monsters incoming!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Guess it's not going to be that simple, after all...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Hmph, they wanna steal Dodoco's treasure, I just know it!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Let's kick 'em out. Then, we can open the box!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew, that's that...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The note implied things wouldn't be that simple. Guess it was because of those monsters.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: But that means... We passed the trial!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, yep! Now then, let's check out what's in this box...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Oh, it's...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A tiny hat?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: A hat for Dodoco!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: In the Dodo Clan, only the awesomest and bestest Dodocos in the land can earn the acknowledgment of the Dodo-King!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Their job is to help out and protect all the other Dodocos, so the Dodo-King gives them a special hat.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: That way, the other Dodocos will recognize them and know who they can go to for help.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! So now your Dodoco is one of these special Dodocos with a hat!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Exactly! The hat makes Dodoco a Dodo-Sorcerer now! She can use special spark magic to help even more people!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Klee—

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: The Knights have informed me about explosions being heard from the forest outside the city...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #Um, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight, Paimon... A little help please...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, that's because we cleared out a Hilichurl camp over there, and a bunch of Slimes too. Plus, we were working on Klee's task.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: That's right!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Mm... And as for the fish over here?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I... might have blasted them. But it's because there were monsters in the lake! I didn't do it on purpose! It's not like those other times...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I see. I take it those other times were on purpose, then?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Um, they weren't... not on purpose?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: *sigh*... I noticed the destroyed camp on the way here, and I saw the monsters fleeing along the shore of Starfell Lake.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: #Am I correct in assuming that's all the damage, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Yeah. You know Paimon, clearing out monsters with a single punch! She's just awesome like that.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Klee.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Come with me. Let's head back.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Ohh... Is it confinement for Klee again?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: #Well, {NICKNAME}'s vouching for you, so I suppose your punishment will just have to be... a meal at the Good Hunter!

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: You've been out and about all day. I'm sure you must be hungry.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: You're the best, Master Jean!

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: You two are more than welcome to join as well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Haha, awesome! Paimon's been craving some Sweet Madame!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Jean treats you, Paimon, and Klee to a meal at the Good Hunter... \nAh, along with Dodoco, the newly crowned "Dodo-Sorcerer" of course. \nWith that, the trial comes to a successful close.
